newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Jan 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Documents from the former Soviet Union support thesis of an alleged collaboration with Soviet Union by former defence minister Charles Hernu.
-- French company heads seek to attract U.S institutional investors, which own more than one-third of the market capitalisation of the Paris bourse.
-- Finance Minister Jean Arthuis confirms Credit Foncier restructuring plan which includes transfer of part of real estate lending and staff to Credit Immobilier de France.

-- French government plans to open up capital of Franco-Italian semi-conductors manufacturer SGS-Thomson to new industrial shareholders. Thomson-CSF will be free to sell in 1997 its 17.3 percent stake in SGS.
